title: Facade – Brackets & Fixings (PER)
activity: Cast-in channels, brackets, torque and pull-out tests
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Are cast-in inserts/channels in tolerance, not missing and not filled with concrete?
Are brackets positioned per SWI0001 and within design tolerance?
Are bracket bolts torqued and marked (line on the nut)?
Anchor pull-out tests done at the agreed rate and recorded?
Control points and datums verified before installation?
As-built survey of the frame issued and any out-of-tolerance inserts remediated per SWI0001?
